entries.summary: Characters with a Touched by (Realm) Virtue can make enchanted items without vis and with workshop help, but only in two Forms, only for one named user, and with strict limits on Range, Duration and Target and no Penetration.
quotes: the effect is limited to Range: Personal or Touch, the Duration must be Sun or less, and the Target must be Individual
These devices cannot Penetrate any Magic Resistance.

entries.title: The Rusticani and Craft Magic
entries.requires: Virtue: Craft Magic (Rusticani, House Ex Miscellanea)
entries.summary: Craft Magic lets a hedge wizard turn any magic he knows into a charged item or lesser enchantment; it needs vis already in the crafted object but takes only as long as making the mundane object.
quotes: the Craft Magic Major Supernatural Virtue permits its possessor to enchant any other magic he knows or Virtue he possesses into a charged item or lesser enchantment

entries.title: Learned Magicians as Inventors
entries.summary: Learned magicians can produce only the equivalent of charged items in the laboratory, but make chartae in hours or days rather than a season, so their inventions are limited to small local benefits.
quotes: While their laboratory activities can only produce the equivalent of charged items, their production of chartae in particular is very swift, taking a matter of hours or days rather than a season.

entries.title: Enriching a Thing of Virtue
entries.summary: Procedure for Enriching Herbs and Objects of Virtue with a season of magical operation to grant a Virtue to the wearer, including the Magic Lore roll to learn the method, the Enrichment Total, the Virtues conferred, drawbacks and Warping.
quotes: make an Intelligence + Magic Lore roll against an Ease Factor of 9
Enrichment Total: Intelligence + Magic Lore + aura

related.text: ArM5 p.184 Penetration of Supernatural Abilities

entries.title: Hedge Magicians and Enriched Things of Virtue
entries.summary: How ungifted hedge magicians use Enriched Things of Virtue to gain minor powers at the cost of accumulating Warping.
quotes: The mechanics of Enriching a Thing of Virtue allow an unGifted character to acquire minor magical powers.

entries.title: Hermetic Magi and Enriched Things of Virtue
entries.summary: Why magi rarely benefit from Enriched Things of Virtue and how one can be built into an invested item or talisman.
quotes: An invested item made from an Enriched Thing of Virtue can only be made into a talisman if the magus Enriched the item himself.

entries.title: Objects of Virtue
entries.summary: Objects of Virtue derive their Virtues from the same Shape and Material Bonuses magi use, and any vis-bearing item with such a bonus to an Art can be Enriched to confer Puissant Art.
quotes: can be Enriched to confer Puissant Art

entries.title: Trees of Virtue
entries.summary: Trees of Virtue hold 1 to 3 pawns of vis tied to their powers and can be Enriched using only part of the tree, which depletes the tree's magic.
quotes: Enriching this item, or collecting the tree's vis, depletes the tree's magical powers.

entries.title: Craft Magic (Rusticani)
entries.summary: Lets a character craft an object in place of casting an effect, with shape and material bonuses capped by his Craft score, and also to make charged items and lesser enchantments of vis-containing objects without spending a season. Four applications, each with its own time and level rules and worked examples.
quotes: though this bonus cannot exceed his Craft score
Use the character's Casting Total or the result of the Supernatural Ability roll as if it were a Lab Total to determine the effect's level and the number of charges
the level of the invested effect cannot exceed five times the number of pawns of vis in the object

related.text: RoP: The Divine pp.137-138 Craft Amulets

entries.title: Magical Craftwork
entries.summary: Introduces the caste of magical crafters who made amulets, talismans and curses, whose writings produced the Learned Magician tradition and remain usable by Coptic speakers.

entries.title: Egyptian Craft Magic and Learned Magic
entries.requires: Learned Magician rules (Hedge Magic: Revised Edition)
entries.summary: Shows how to simulate Ancient Egyptian amulets, talismans and curses with Learned Magic Techniques and Forms, noting that Egyptian magic lacks the Range, Target and Duration limits and Difficult Arts, and assumes high casting and lab totals.
quotes: Troupes using the Learned Magician rules to create Egyptian spells should assume that the Egyptians had very high casting and laboratory totals

entries.title: Defixio Magic
entries.summary: Defixio magic let ancient cultists cast spells on targets they could name without any Arcane Connection, by preparing defixiones; Hermetic integration yields a new Duration and a new Range.

entries.title: Learning Defixio Magic
entries.summary: Sources describing defixiones and a roll that lets a magus realize their effects break the Hermetic limit of needing an Arcane Connection.
quotes: Intelligence + Magic Theory roll against an Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: Defixio Lore
entries.summary: Describes the Major Supernatural Virtue and Ability that let a cultist prepare a defixio, with cult Art limits, a day and vis per magnitude, and a roll against an Ease Factor that depends on how well the target is identified.
quotes: The creator must spend one day and expend one pawn of vis per magnitude of the spell or Ability in preparing the defixio.
After the defixio is created, the preparer must roll Intelligence + Defixio Lore + a stress die.
Defixio Lore's Penetration total is equal to the amount that the stress roll exceeds the target Ease Factor.

entries.title: Fectores Versus Hermetic Fectores
entries.summary: Explains how Laniena splits its Gifted recruits between non-Hermetic Fectores (made Gifted Companions of House Ex Miscellanea) and Hermetic Fectores, what the initiation scripts can and cannot do, and the legal justification for the programme.
quotes: Two of every three Gifted individuals sent to or discovered by the oppidum are trained as Fectores before being admitted into the Order as Gifted Companions within House Ex Miscellanea
Laniena is under strict instructions from House Tremere not to give Hermetic training to any dhampirs

entries.title: Fector Characters
entries.requires: Social Status Virtue: Fector (Tradition: Hunters' Arts)
entries.summary: Character-creation rules for a non-Hermetic Fector: the Gift plus the free Fector Social Status Virtue, all three Practice Arts and three Foe Arts, free Second Sight, a five-year apprenticeship with a set pool of experience, and permitted starting Abilities.
quotes: A Fector has all three Practice Arts of Scry, Ban, and Slay, and can choose three Foe Arts.
During this time, the Fector receives 120 experience points that can be spent on the Hunters' Arts or on Abilities.

entries.title: Hermetic Fectores
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea (societas of Murat of Terezin)
entries.summary: Character-creation rules for a Hermetic Fector, a magus Ex Miscellanea who has one Practice Art as a free Major non-Hermetic Virtue with a Foe Art, a free Minor Magical Focus in harming a creature, and the Weak Spontaneous Magic Flaw.
quotes: Their free Minor Hermetic Virtue is a Minor Magical Focus in harming a particular supernatural creature
Their Major Hermetic Flaw is Weak Spontaneous Magic; the methodical preparation typical of a hunter comes at the expense of flexibility.

entries.title: Kassalan Exorcists
entries.requires: Training by the Mortuary Society of Kassala
entries.summary: Describes the typical Virtues, Abilities and tactics of an exorcist of the Mortuary Society, who specialises in laying ghosts and the walking dead.
quotes: Exorcists tend to concentrate on low level, high Penetration effects, and often work in concert to destroy powerful ghosts.

entries.title: New Virtue: Kassalan Exorcism
entries.summary: A limited supernatural casting method for wards against ghosts and the walking dead and for stripping their Might, with its own fatigue cost, preparation time, Casting Total and Penetration rules.
quotes: To cast a spell you must expend a Fatigue level, whether the spell succeeds or fails.
Your Casting Total is equal to (Stamina + Organization Lore: Mortuary Society + Aura modifier + stress die) / 2.

entries.title: Kassalan Dust
entries.requires: Virtue: Kassalan Exorcism or Organization Lore: Mortuary Society
entries.summary: The gold-based dust required for Kassalan Exorcism, with its bonuses against Corpse Magic and the dead and its cost in gold.
quotes: A handful also adds +3 to uses of the Corpse Magic Supernatural Ability to command a corpse to return to its grave or prevent it from being affected by Corpse Magic.

entries.title: Sihr (Summoning and Bargaining with Jinn)
entries.summary: A Supernatural Accelerated Ability for summoning a jinni and bargaining it into service. Covers discerning a jinni's Might, the vis cost and Summoning Total, extra summoning time, the Bargain Total against an Ease Factor, botches, and how many jinn may be kept in service.
quotes: Summoning Total: Presence + Sihr + Aura + stress die
Bargain Total: Communication + Bargain + Summoning Strength + stress die
Ease Factor: 18 + Bargain Modifiers

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine ch.5 Mythic Islam

entries.title: Bargain Modifiers (Sahirs)
entries.summary: Table of modifiers to the Ease Factor of a sahir's bargain with a jinni, depending on the scope of the terms, length of service, any duty accepted and vis spent above or below the standard cost.

entries.title: Typical Duties for Sahirs
entries.summary: Examples of simple and onerous duties a sahir may accept to modify a bargain with a jinni.

entries.title: The Alchemists of Soba
entries.requires: Virtue: Soban Alchemy or Alchemist of Soba
entries.summary: Explains how to build a Soban Alchemist character, the Abilities and patronage they need, the obligation to stay near Soba, and how the craft is taught from books or by initiation.
quotes: They also require the Profession: Apothecary Ability to manage and run a well-stocked alchemist's laboratory.

entries.title: Soban Alchemy
entries.summary: Introduces Soban Alchemy as a supernatural science that makes temporary changes to matter, separate from Philosophiae reagents and not reproducible by Rego Craft magic.
quotes: Unlike alchemical reagents made with Philosophiae, Soban Alchemy is a supernatural science, and cannot be duplicated with Rego Craft magic.

entries.title: New Ability: Soban Alchemy (Sovereign Reagent)
entries.summary: Full procedure for making and applying Sovereign Reagent: dose cost and seasonal limits, which properties can change, Duration by Ability score, Casting Total against property Ease Factors, Penetration and Warping.
quotes: Each dose of Sovereign Reagent costs the equivalent of a Mythic Pound of ingredients, or else a pawn of Muto vis.
After applying the reagent, generate a Casting Total from Intelligence + Soban Alchemy + Aura modifier + stress die against an Ease Factor determined by the type of change desired:
The Penetration Total is equal to Casting Total – Ease Factor + Penetration Bonus.

entries.title: Craft Amulets: Shape and Material Bonuses
entries.summary: Lists materials, shapes and colors that give bonuses to enchanting amulets, plus extra bonuses for particular combinations; the total is capped by the crafter's Craft Amulets score.
quotes: The total bonus provided by shapes or materials is limited to the character's Craft Amulets Score.
Forming the amulet from a coin provides an additional +1 bonus.

entries.title: Craft Amulets (Ability and Amulet Creation)
entries.summary: Explains how Minor and Major amulets are made with Touch range and Worn duration, how long they take, the totals used to craft them, and how penetration is handled.
quotes: CRAFT MINOR AMULET TOTAL: Dexterity + Craft Amulets + Shape and Material Bonus + Dominion Aura Bonus
CRAFT MAJOR AMULET TOTAL: Dexterity + Craft Amulets + Holy Method + Holy Power + Shape and Material Bonus + Dominion Aura Bonus
The crafter's Craft Amulets Total must be at least double the target level of effect.

entries.title: The Secrets of the Grigori
entries.requires: Virtue: a Grigori Secret, or integration of Grigori magic
entries.summary: Grigori Secrets are Supernatural Virtues letting a user treat vis of three linked Arts as interchangeable and ignore matching requisites, at the cost of doubled botch dice in Divine or Infernal auras; integration offers a Major Breakthrough to a Hermetic Legacy and a Hermetic Breakthrough to break the Limit of Vis.
quotes: Anyone who uses vis through any of the Secrets in either a Divine or Infernal aura must roll double the usual number of botch dice for the vis.
This qualifies as a Major Breakthrough, requiring 45 breakthrough points.
If the magus wishes to break the Limit of Vis, it requires a Hermetic Breakthrough with 60 breakthrough points.

entries.title: The Chiefs of Ten and their Secrets
entries.summary: Lists the Technique and pair of Forms covered by the Secret of each known Watcher, which is the template for each Grigori Supernatural and Hermetic Virtue.
quotes: Araquiel: Creo, Terram, Corpus
Shamsiel: Rego, Ignem, Vim

entries.title: Gruagachan variant for Greece
entries.summary: Suggests a Pelasgic Greek variant of the Gruagachan hedge tradition that swaps enchanted tattoos for spirit magic and access to Defixio Lore.
quotes: in exchange for losing the ability to create enchanted tattoos

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal, pages 114-119 (Goetic Arts)

entries.title: The Makhai (Greek Muspelli variant)
entries.summary: Notes a Greek variant of the Muspelli wizard tradition whose sorcerers serve the monsters born of Earth to avenge the titans.
quotes: Greek sorcerers who serve the monstrous Ekhidna and Typhon

entries.title: Caerfloron's Magical Tradition (Homunculus Wizards)
entries.summary: Describes the magi of Caerfloron as Homunculus Wizards whose magic comes from a manikin made of a Mandrake of Virtue, listing the Virtues and Flaws their tradition grants and the plant-like way they sustain themselves.
quotes: Their magical tradition grants them the Greater Immunity to Deprivation and Faerie Magic Virtues, and the Homunculus Wizard Flaw.

entries.title: Homunculi Wizards
entries.requires: Flaw: Homunculus Wizard (character with The Gift)
entries.summary: Explains hedge wizards who gain a faerie version of The Gift through a bond with a homunculus: what they can do, their dependence on feeding and hiding the homunculus, and how to build one as a character.
quotes: To play a Homunculus Wizard as a character, take The Gift and the Homunculus Wizard Flaw during character creation.

related.text: House Merinita outer mystery of Faerie Magic

entries.title: Ability: Ceremony (group effort)
entries.summary: The Supernatural Ability that lets a group combine totals: each participant adds Characteristic plus Ability to the focus character's total, with a leader limiting contributors and a penalty if there is no leader; it can also boost seasonal activities.
quotes: Ceremony Bonus: Characteristic + Ability total of each participant
All participants add their totals of the appropriate Characteristic + Ability to the focus character's total.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.36 Ceremony

entries.title: Chthonic Magic
entries.requires: Supernatural Ability: Chthonic Magic (lineage, tradition, societas, Hermetic Virtue or Mystery Cult)
entries.summary: Low magic associated with underworld gods and night spirits that is ambiguously Infernal: the magus is attuned to Magic and Infernal auras, can use Infernal vis safely and maleficia Ranges/Durations/Targets, and gains a doubled lowest Art after a sinful act.
quotes: Finally, a chthonic magus may always add his lowest Art score to his Lab Total or Casting Total twice
The chthonic magus becomes attuned to both Magical and Infernal auras, and so gains Warping Points from neither, and the benefits of both.

entries.title: Comprehend Magic (Ability)
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability for analysing the magic in an object, person, aura or vis. A Comprehension Total is compared to an Ease Factor by source of magic, with more rounds of study revealing more, and the insight boosts the user's spells and lab work against the studied target.
quotes: Comprehension Total: Perception + Comprehend Magic + stress die
The observer may add twice his Comprehend Magic score to the Casting Total of any spontaneous Muto, Perdo, or Rego Vim spell used against the object or creature studied

entries.title: Debterah (Ethiopian holy societas)
entries.requires: Holy Societas: Debterah (Ethiopian church lay cantors and amulet-makers)
entries.summary: Sidebar on Saint Yared and the debterah, an Ethiopian Christian holy societas, giving its favored Abilities and a stand-in Virtue and Ability package for using debterah without Realms of Power: the Divine. Also notes the Yared chant books as a summa on Organization Lore: Ethiopian Church.
quotes: Adjuration, Blessing, Craft Amulets, Invocation.
These books collectively act as a summa of Organization Lore: Ethiopian Church, Level 5, Quality 8.

related.text: Realms of Power: the Divine Revised p.34, 37, 48-50, 137

entries.title: Katadesmos Magic (Greek Defixio tradition)
entries.summary: The Greek form of the lost Defixio tradition, whose curses work at any range without an Arcane Connection and can be conditional triggers, and which lets non-Hermetic wizards take the Leadworker Virtue.
quotes: a wizard could enact a curse on a victim at any range without the need of an Arcane Connection

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages, page 143 (Leadworker)

entries.title: Dream Interpretation (Ability)
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability used either as a Holy Method for activating powers or as direct divination from dreams, with a preparation ritual, hours of contemplation and an Intelligence roll against an Ease Factor based on an equivalent Hermetic spell.
quotes: He may then make an Intelligence + Dream Interpretation roll.
The Ease Factor is the level of the equivalent Momentary non-ritual Intellego Hermetic spell.

entries.title: The Exsules: A Renegade Hermetic Tradition
entries.requires: Tradition: Exsules of Fenistal (outcast House Merinita)
entries.summary: Profiles the isolated Hermetic exiles outside the Order, listing the Flaws they all share from their isolation and imperfect Parma Magica, the Virtues common among them, and how their magic should feel alien to Hermetic magi.
quotes: all suffer the Weird Magic Flaw due to their isolation from the Order
all have inherited the Flawed Parma Magica Flaw

related.text: Chapter 4: The Forest (Paths through the Forest)

entries.title: New Virtue: Folk Magic
entries.summary: A new Minor Supernatural Virtue giving very minor spell-like magic in one narrow area, keyed to a Realm Lore. It explains the allowed categories of effect, the casting cost and preparation, and the halved Casting Total formula.
quotes: Your Casting Total is equal to (Stamina + (Realm) Lore + Aura modifier + stress die) / 2.
To cast a spell you must expend a fatigue level, whether the spell succeeds or fails.

entries.title: Folk Dancer (Communal Dance Magic)
entries.summary: A vestigial communal magical tradition in which a troupe of folk dancers performs a long dance, each passing a Dexterity + Carouse roll, to create a minor magical effect; troupes know only a few fixed dances negotiated at character creation.
quotes: A troupe of a dozen or more folk dancers, who all make Dexterity + Carouse rolls of 9+ can perform a dance

entries.title: Cursewood: Forest Lore and communing with the forest spirit
entries.requires: Ability: Forest Lore (Guardians of the Forest)
entries.summary: A table of what a character with Forest Lore learns or can do in a foreign forest at each Ability score from 3 upward, from learning the spirit's name to being automatically judged worthy.
quotes: can try to commune with the forest spirit, but as this is a foreign place the character must have an Ability level of at least 3 to have any effect.
Character may find vis, although it is vis sordida.

related.text: Guardians of the Forest p.37 Forest Lore

entries.title: Impacts on Non-Hermetic Magicians
entries.requires: Saga: the world after the Second Titanomachy
entries.summary: Summarises how each non-Hermetic tradition fares once magic is regulated by the Golden Chain: which are already connected, which must find patrons, and which lose the ability to bind Magic and Faerie spirits.
quotes: Learned Magicians who Entreat the Magic Powers are already connected to the Golden Chain
Other wizards have to find a patron in the same way as Hermetic magi.

related.text: The Cradle and the Crescent Chapter 3

entries.title: Guan king magic (meceny)
entries.summary: Community-ceremony magic of the Guan kings: it cannot fail or botch when the traditional formulae are used, and every meceny can perform a fixed set of effects with village help plus two minor effects unique to his tribe.
quotes: The magic of Guan kings is performed with community ceremonies, and cannot fail or botch, provided the ancient and tested formulae are used.
All meceny can perform the following effects, if assisted by their villages:

related.text: ArM5 p.153 Coerce the Spirits of the Night

entries.title: The Army of the Faerie Gods
entries.summary: Gives a quick way to statistic the einherjar warriors from an existing template and changes how Muspelli Warping works once they are awakened, so that a failed Heipt Roll brings a group of them down on the Muspelli.
quotes: use the Berserker or Grizzled Veteran Template (ArM5 page 21) but also give him a Faerie Might of 5 (Corpus)

entries.title: The Snatcher of the Moon
entries.summary: Worked example of a Muspelli utiseta ritual, setting out the Ease Factor, Range, Duration and Target components and the Power Modifiers a practitioner needs, and noting that separate Muspelli cannot combine powers.
quotes: Sjonhverfing Ease Factor 48
(Base 12, +9 Sight, +15 Decade, +12 Boundary)
would need Power Modifiers of x5 or x6

entries.title: Sin-Eating
entries.summary: Describes Sin-Eating as a cultural variant of Curse-Throwing, treating a sin as an affliction of Minor, Serious or Major magnitude.
quotes: The magnitude of the unforgiven sin should be considered to be a Minor, Serious, or Major Affliction as appropriate.

entries.title: Lore of the Dead (Supernatural Ability and Necromantic Rites)
entries.summary: Explains how a character with the Lore of the Dead Virtue casts necromantic rites, ceremonially in an hour or casually in a round, with the casting totals and Penetration formula, followed by four sample rites (Eyes of the Dead, Touch of Ghostly Calling, Dirge, Anchored in the Veil) with Ease Factors and vis costs.
quotes: Stamina + Lore of the Dead + Shape & Material bonus + stress die
Casual rites take only one round, but the casting total is halved unless a Fatigue level is spent.
Casting Total – Ease Factor + Penetration ability

entries.title: The Order of Odin: Norse Wizard Options
entries.requires: Storyguide decision: existence of Norse wizards
entries.summary: Leaves it to the storyguide to decide whether Norse wizards exist and how organized they are, from a Norse equivalent of the Order of Hermes to scattered weak hedge magicians, and lists the kinds of magic Norse legends attribute to them.
quotes: No single Norse magician should be capable of doing all these things.

entries.title: Siren Song (Seirenes)
entries.summary: A Major Virtue letting the character command those who hear her music, resolved as a Communication + Music roll against the target's Stamina roll with a bonus table by command severity. Limits help from other musicians and explains how it combines with Enchanting Music.
quotes: A successful roll of Communication + Music versus the target's Stamina roll allows the character to issue a command to any individual or group who hears the music
No more than two musicians' scores can assist the singer in performing a song

entries.title: A Note on True Names
entries.summary: Explains Egyptian casualness about True Names (ka names, rens) listed in tombs and how shabti servants answer the name and shift the target of curses.
quotes: The owner had shabtis, little statue servants, who answered his True Name for him.

entries.title: The Varcolac and Vukodlak (werewolf living vampires)
entries.summary: Describes werewolf-like varcolaci, how they come about, their wolf brotherhoods that hunt vampires and the mischievous ones that are Nightwalkers. Says which Virtue a varcolac character takes and that they die as bestial vampires.
quotes: A varcolac character has either the Shapeshifter Virtue if he was born a werewolf, or the Skinchanger Virtue if he has learned to change shape.
